unknown_classifications.proposition_text: For cattle slurry, the available nitrogen for crop uptake in the growing season in which it is spread on and after 1st January 2014 is 40%.

unknown_classifications.proposition_text: For pig slurry, the available nitrogen for crop uptake in the growing season in which it is spread on and after 1st January 2014 is 50%.

unknown_classifications.proposition_text: A chicken used for producing eggs for human consumption from 17 weeks (not caged) produces 0.12 kilograms of manure (including litter), 1.5 grams of nitrogen, and 1.1 grams of phosphate daily.
